about_the_game:
3D Horror Escape Action Game – Sharpen your reflexes and memory to find the exit.

Relentlessly pursued by looming terror, you must keep running in this ultimate survival challenge.

A single moment of hesitation could mean the end. Experience fear and thrill beyond the boundaries of gaming.

[A Space Full of Mysteries]

This is no ordinary exploration game. The visuals progress in real time, leaving no room for contemplation.
Your only allies are your reflexes and memory.
In an atmosphere so tense it drives you to the brink of madness, the sole path to survival is finding the exit.

[Story]

The cold floor jolts the girl awake. Her head is foggy. Where… is this place?
On her way home, something suddenly dragged her away—then, nothing.
As she opens her eyes, she finds herself in an unfamiliar, eerie space. Flickering lights, a damp stench, the sound of dripping water breaking the silence.
Then—
A distant scream pierces the air.

"GYAAAAAH!!"

Her body freezes in terror.
From the darkness, slow, creaking footsteps draw closer.

Something is here.

She must run. But there is no exit.
And so begins a nightmare escape.

[Stunning Visuals]

With breathtaking graphics, this game amplifies the feeling of immersive horror to the absolute limit.
The hyper-realistic visuals make you feel as though you’ve been thrown into a horror movie.
As you flee in terror, one question remains—can you survive?
